  <h4>use</h4>
  <p>
    The synchronous service <code>Com_SwitchIpduTxMode</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>) switches the transmission mode of the I-PDU referenced by <code>PduId</code> to the state specified in parameter <code>Mode</code>. The function is declared via <code>Com.h</code>, has service ID <code>0x27</code>, and returns no value (<code>void</code>).
  </p>
  <p>
    If the transmission mode changes as a result of the call, the new transmission mode takes effect immediately (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>). If the requested mode was already active for the affected I-PDU, the call has no effect (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>).
  </p>
  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>, the function is reentrant for different I-PDU IDs, but not reentrant for the same <code>PduId</code>.
  </p>
  <h4>Interaction and Timing Behavior</h4>
  <p>
    If the transmission mode of an I-PDU is set explicitly via <code>Com_SwitchIpduTxMode</code>, AUTOSAR COM delays the cyclic transmissions of this I-PDU by the configured offset <code>ComTxModeTimeOffset</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00881" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00881">[SWS_Com_00881]</a>).
  </p>
  <h4>Error handling</h4>
  <p>
    Neither return values nor specific error codes or notifications to DET or DEM are identified for this service in the element specification (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>).
  </p>
  <p class="ai-note">
    This usage note was generated automatically based on the AUTOSAR specification R20-11.
  </p>

  <p>According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00819" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00819">[SWS_Com_00819]</a>, the enumeration type <code>Com_StatusType</code> describes the initialization and operating state of the AUTOSAR COM module. The type is declared via the header file <code>Com.h</code> and serves as the return value of the API service <code>Com_GetStatus()</code>.</p>
  <h4>Value Range and Semantics</h4>
  <ul>
    <li><code>COM_UNINIT</code>: Has the fixed numerical value <code>0x00</code> (value <code>0</code>). This state signals that the AUTOSAR COM module is not initialized or not usable. According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00819" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00819">[SWS_Com_00819]</a>, this is mandatorily the default value immediately after a reset.</li>
    <li><code>COM_INIT</code>: Indicates that the AUTOSAR COM module has been successfully initialized and is operational or usable.</li>
  </ul>
  <h4>use</h4>
  <p>As the return type of the function <code>Com_GetStatus()</code>, <code>Com_StatusType</code> serves to determine the operational readiness of the module. The COM module is only usable after switching to the state <code>COM_INIT</code>, whereas no regular use is possible under <code>COM_UNINIT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00819" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00819">[SWS_Com_00819]</a>.</p>
  <p>Specific error codes, DET or DEM messages, as well as specifications regarding reentrancy or concurrency are not defined for this type in the specification, as it is an elementary status enumeration.</p>
  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification of AUTOSAR R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="97d9f9cf3cd11f4f6f77106ca3fa02cee14d224bc89a3e29e936f2f87ecceaf3" data-trace-output="af97b4375f0ebea472d9b4c3f8613b8aa28288de418e1d19503ffebc470192b5" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>Usage and Semantics</h4>
  <p>
    The asynchronous function <code>Com_SendSignalGroupArray</code> copies the data of the passed pointer <code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code> directly into the assigned I-PDU <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00851" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00851">[SWS_Com_00851]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00852" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00852">[SWS_Com_00852]</a>. The provided data must correspond to the array representation of the signal group identified via <code>SignalGroupId</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00851" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00851">[SWS_Com_00851]</a>.
  </p>

  <h4>Return Values and Error Handling</h4>
  <p>
    The return value of type <code>uint8</code> signals the result of the request <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00851" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00851">[SWS_Com_00851]</a>:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service call was successfully accepted.</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the call failed due to a development error.</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer (transport protocol) is locked for processing large data types.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    With respect to reentrancy, <code>Com_SendSignalGroupArray</code> is non-reentrant for the same signal group, but reentrant for different signal groups <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00851" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00851">[SWS_Com_00851]</a>. Furthermore, the API is exclusively available when the pre-configuration switch <code>ComEnableSignalGroupArrayApi</code> is enabled <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00853" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00853">[SWS_Com_00853]</a>.
  </p>

  <h4>Interaction</h4>
  <p>
    A call to <code>Com_SendSignalGroupArray</code> is processed by the AUTOSAR COM module identically to <code>Com_SendSignalGroup</code> regarding transfer properties, the selection of the I-PDU transmission mode, and signal flow <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00847" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00847">[SWS_Com_00847]</a>.
  </p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification for AUTOSAR Classic Release R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="8aa86d75cdcc960b3e04cd52a9579891683e1724997124f5a3878c7234b8da44" data-trace-output="f469f36132b03a8b189d7336bfd390aae5e7de990822e3d4333becf11d4fa01d" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>Usage and Operation</h4>
  <p>The synchronous function <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupArray</code> copies the received signal group array representation from the I-PDU into the memory area referenced by the output parameter <code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00855" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00855">[SWS_Com_00855]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00849" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00849">[SWS_Com_00849]</a>). The signal group to be read is identified via the parameter <code>SignalGroupId</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>). For reception filtering and transmission mode selection, signal processing supports the filter types <code>ALWAYS</code>, <code>NEVER</code>, <code>MASKED_NEW_EQUALS_X</code>, <code>MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_X</code>, <code>MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_MASKED_OLD</code>, and <code>ONE_EVERY_N</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00848" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00848">[SWS_Com_00848]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Error Handling and Return Values</h4>
  <p>The service returns a status code of type <code>uint8</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>):</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service call was successfully accepted and executed (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer is locked for the transmission or processing of large data types (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group was stopped or the call failed due to a development error (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>). In this case, the AUTOSAR COM module nevertheless copies the last known data of the I-PDU or the initial values <code>ComSignalInitValues</code> (if no data has been received yet) to the destination address <code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00857" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00857">[SWS_Com_00857]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Constraints</h4>
  <p>The API is exclusively available when the configuration parameter <code>ComEnableSignalGroupArrayApi</code> is enabled (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00856" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00856">[SWS_Com_00856]</a>). Regarding concurrency, <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupArray</code> is non-reentrant for the same signal group, but may be called concurrently for different signal groups (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>).</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification AUTOSAR CP R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="d53507ffbab2f5dc751f6b94d742db2ed8daf66a3db58498fd48659b76d8b3a1" data-trace-output="214828107be41fd0bb31390860e8dee8734a169965fb7ecf3ead83802560f325" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

<p>The synchronous function <code>Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>) serves to update internal metadata of an I-PDU and subsequently trigger the transmit process. When called, the AUTOSAR COM module copies the metadata starting from the passed memory address <code>MetaData</code>, taking into account the configured length of the global metadata type (<code>Meta Data Type</code>) of the respective I-PDU, and triggers transmission (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</p>

<h4>Parameters and Return Values</h4>
<ul>
  <li><code>PduId</code>: Identifier of the I-PDU to be triggered for transmission (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</li>
  <li><code>MetaData</code>: Pointer to the metadata of the signal (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</li>
  <li><code>E_OK</code>: The I-PDU was successfully triggered for transmission (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</li>
  <li><code>E_NOT_OK</code>: The I-PDU is stopped; transmission could not be triggered (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</li>
</ul>

<h4>Interaction and Error Behavior</h4>
<p>According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00862" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00862">[SWS_Com_00862]</a>, the AUTOSAR COM module may only trigger the transmission of the I-PDU with the specified identifier if the I-PDU is in the "started" state. If, however, the I-PDU is in the "stopped" state, transmission is denied and the function reports the failure via return value <code>E_NOT_OK</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00862" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00862">[SWS_Com_00862]</a>).</p>

<h4>Characteristics and Limitations</h4>
<p>The service has the Service ID <code>0x28</code>, is synchronous, and is explicitly defined as non-reentrant (<code>Non Reentrant</code>) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>). The function declaration is provided via the header file <code>Com.h</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>).</p>

<p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification requirements of AUTOSAR Release R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="f964dc667e230e508e18f3824f41bd1659e3da7e2c36a1d996e1b60f087da3bf" data-trace-output="12e25a9f2f4879d7c91dd6726b9fb72988b0f09a67747ee91c1c38bd3c04b38e" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>use</h4>
  <p>The synchronous function <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91001">[SWS_Com_91001]</a> starts a pre-configured I-PDU group. After the call, cyclic I-PDUs of this group, for example, are sent cyclically. The interface has no return value (<code>void</code>) and is provided via the header <code>Com.h</code> (service ID <code>0x03</code>).</p>
  <p>The function expects two input parameters:</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>IpduGroupId</code> (type <code>Com_IpduGroupIdType</code>): Identifies the ID of the I-PDU group to be started.</li>
    <li><code>initialize</code> (type <code>boolean</code>): Controls whether the data of the I-PDUs of this group shall be initialized or re-initialized before the start.</li>
  </ul>
  <p>If <code>initialize</code> is passed with <code>true</code>, all I-PDUs of the group behave as after a start-up of the COM module. This means that, among other things, the values of <code>old_value</code> for filter objects as well as the shadow buffers of signal groups are (re-)initialized before the start of the I-PDU group.</p>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>Regarding concurrency behavior, <code>Com_IpduGroupStart</code> is reentrant for different I-PDU groups. For the same I-PDU group, the function is non-reentrant; competing or nested calls with an identical <code>IpduGroupId</code> are therefore not permitted.</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This text was generated by an AI based on the AUTOSAR specification R20-11.</p>
</div>

  <p>The function <code>Com_IpduGroupStop</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>) serves to deactivate or stop a pre-configured I-PDU group in the communication module <code>Com</code>. After the service is called, the associated communication processes are stopped; for example, cyclic I-PDUs are stopped after calling <code>Com_IpduGroupStop</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Call and Parameters</h4>
  <p>The function is provided via the header <code>Com.h</code> and has the service ID <code>0x04</code>. Execution is synchronous, and the function returns no value (<code>void</code>).</p>
  <ul>
    <li><strong><code>IpduGroupId</code></strong> (input parameter of type <code>Com_IpduGroupIdType</code>): Identifier (ID) of the pre-configured I-PDU group to be stopped (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>). Input/output parameters (inout/out) are not present for this call.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Reentrancy</h4>
  <p>The function <code>Com_IpduGroupStop</code> is reentrant for different I-PDU groups, but non-reentrant for the same I-PDU group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>). For parallel calls from different contexts for the same group ID, it must therefore be ensured that no concurrent execution takes place.</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification AUTOSAR Classic R20-11.</p>
</div>

  <p>The function <code>Com_DisableReceptionDM</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91003" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91003">[SWS_Com_91003]</a>) deactivates the reception deadline monitoring (Reception Deadline Monitoring) for all I-PDUs within the passed I-PDU group.</p>
  <h4>use</h4>
  <ul>

    <li><strong>Parameters:</strong> Via the input parameter <code>IpduGroupId</code>, the identifier of that I-PDU group is passed for whose assigned I-PDUs reception monitoring is to be deactivated.</li>
    <li><strong>Return value and semantics:</strong> The function has no return value (<code>void</code>) and operates synchronously (Sync/Async: Synchronous).</li>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <ul>

    <li><strong>Service ID:</strong> The call is defined in the module <code>Com</code> with the service ID <code>0x05</code>.</li>
  </ul>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="c68cd88180d973b52d42cdddaae5b0b6d6d1f791a12b836567ba06c9a97d0e42" data-trace-output="28f037ddfa2ed5f3d9e8ffcf129ad0e1b13be1caa2ad464b1bb30b09a84df345" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>use</h4>
  <p>The function <code>Com_EnableReceptionDM</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91004">[SWS_Com_91004]</a>) activates the reception deadline monitoring (Reception Deadline Monitoring) for all I-PDUs assigned to the passed I-PDU group. The call is processed synchronously and has the service ID <code>0x06</code>. The interface is provided via the header <code>Com.h</code>.</p>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Parameters:</strong> Via the input parameter <code>IpduGroupId</code> (type <code>Com_IpduGroupIdType</code>), the identifier of that I-PDU group is passed for whose I-PDUs deadline monitoring is to be activated.</li>
    <li><strong>Return value:</strong> The function returns no value (<code>void</code>) and has no input/output or output parameters.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>With regard to concurrency behavior, <code>Com_EnableReceptionDM</code> according to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91004">[SWS_Com_91004]</a> is reentrant for different I-PDU groups. However, for the same I-PDU group, the function is non-reentrant (<code>Non reentrant for the same I - PDU group</code>). Parallel calls in the system must therefore ensure that accesses to identical groups are excluded or synchronized.</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note is based on the specification of AUTOSAR Classic Release R20-11.</p>
</div>

  <p>The function <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>, Service ID <code>0x49</code>, available via <code>Com.h</code>) serves for the synchronous reception of a signal together with the associated metadata from the communication module.</p>
  <h4>Usage and Parameters</h4>
  <p>When called, the function copies the payload data of the signal addressed via <code>SignalId</code> (input parameter of type <code>Com_SignalIdType</code>) to the destination address referenced via the output pointer <code>SignalDataPtr</code>. In addition, the received metadata is copied to the position indicated by the output parameter <code>MetaDataPtr</code> (type <code>uint8*</code>) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>).</p>
  <p>The function has synchronous call semantics and returns a return value of type <code>uint8</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>). Interpretation: The exact meaning of the return code (for example success or error status) is not detailed in the interface description, but presumably reflects the status of the receive operation.</p>
  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Reentrancy:</strong> The function is non-reentrant for the same signal, but reentrant for different signals (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>). Parallel calls for identical signal IDs must therefore be synchronized or avoided.</li>
  </ul>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="5d92f91539e6f9ceb5510c7e9529cd2fa830b518d6f5fa58ea9d1501047d1fa8" data-trace-output="1266cfea6879a4d9c3e9327f664dfd897f10f2da89a58d22aa71dd8a7cc35b90" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

<h4>use</h4>
<p>The synchronous function <code>Com_ReceiveDynSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>) reads a dynamic signal based on its identifier <code>SignalId</code>. In this process, the received signal payload data is copied to the memory location referenced by <code>SignalDataPtr</code>, the actual length of the dynamic signal is provided via <code>Length</code>, and the associated metadata is written to address <code>MetaDataPtr</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>). The function declaration is made available via <code>Com.h</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>).</p>

<h4>Return Values and Error Handling</h4>
<p>The return value of type <code>uint8</code> reports the result of the execution (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>):</p>
<ul>
<li><code>E_OK</code>: The service was executed successfully and the signal data as well as metadata were accepted (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>).</li>
<li><code>E_NOT_OK</code>: Occurs when the value passed via <code>Length</code> is smaller than the received length of the dynamic signal (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>). Interpretation: The caller presumably must initialize <code>Length</code> with the available buffer size prior to the call, although the parameter is listed under the out parameters in the formal interface definition.</li>
<li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the service failed due to a development error (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>).</li>
<li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer (Transport Protocol) is currently locked (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>).</li>
</ul>

<h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
<p>Regarding reentrancy, <code>Com_ReceiveDynSignalWithMetaData</code> is not reentrant for the same signal, but may be called reentrantly for signals that are different from one another (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91006">[SWS_Com_91006]</a>). Parallel calls for the same <code>SignalId</code> from concurrent contexts must therefore be excluded or protected.</p>

<p class="ai-note">This text was generated by an AI based on the R20-11 specification.</p>

</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="2ce42a21c9f20def369897f112423ecfa4b01411a63697c001dc5edc309bc969" data-trace-output="cb2355d998e251d4b65b7a01c45b9685750c8b73eb92616b91ca0bddf01b55de" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <p>The function <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>) serves for the synchronous reception of a signal group including the associated metadata. Upon call, the service copies the received signal group from the I-PDU into the shadow buffer (Shadow Buffer), while the received metadata is copied to the memory location specified by output parameter <code>MetaDataPtr</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>). The service is declared via header <code>Com.h</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Parameters and Return Values</h4>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>SignalGroupId</strong> (in): Identifier of the signal group to be received (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</li>
    <li><strong>MetaDataPtr</strong> (out): Pointer to the memory area where the metadata of the signal group is stored (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</li>
  </ul>
  <p>The return value of type <code>uint8</code> signals the execution status (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>):</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service request was successfully accepted (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the service failed due to a development error (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer is locked for handling large data types (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency</h4>
  <p>The service is not reentrant for the same signal group, but may be called concurrently for different signal groups (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Interaction</h4>
  <p>While individual signals with metadata are queried via <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>), <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91007">[SWS_Com_91007]</a>) processes signal groups after their reception via the lower-layer indication <code>Com_RxIndication</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00123" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00123">[SWS_Com_00123]</a>), which provides the received PDU data together with metadata.</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the AUTOSAR specification R20-11.</p>
</div>

  <h4>Usage and Semantics</h4>
  <p>
    The function <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupArrayWithMetaData</code> (service ID <code>0x4c</code>, declared in <code>Com.h</code>) serves for the synchronous reception of a signal group array together with the associated metadata <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>. The service copies the received representation of the signal group from the PDU to buffer <code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code> and stores the received metadata at the location designated by <code>MetaDataPtr</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>SignalGroupId</code> (in): Identifier of the signal group to be received <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.</li>
    <li><code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code> (out): Reference to the destination area for storing the received signal group array <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.</li>
    <li><code>MetaDataPtr</code> (out): Pointer to the metadata of the signal group <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.</li>
  </ul>
  <p>
    The function has no return value (<code>void</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.
  </p>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    Regarding reentrancy, the call is not reentrant for the same signal group, but reentrant for different signal groups <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91008">[SWS_Com_91008]</a>.
  </p>

  <h4>Interaction</h4>
  <p>
    The function represents the counterpart for signal group arrays to the individual signal reception services, in particular to <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a> and regular <code>Com_ReceiveSignal</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00198" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00198">[SWS_Com_00198]</a>. The provided data and metadata originate from previously received PDUs that are passed to the Com module via, for example, <code>Com_RxIndication</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00123" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00123">[SWS_Com_00123]</a>.
  </p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification AUTOSAR CP R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="2c23fee8c3069ca6904057ca0043636d163f36b37ba2785d14ab969a1a2c50c9" data-trace-output="958f10251d7838c32e169704a145f5ff1091356b673251344d18335d6db0fc3b" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <p>The asynchronous service <code>Com_SendSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>) updates the signal object referenced via <code>SignalId</code> with the payload data from <code>SignalDataPtr</code> and the associated metadata via <code>MetaDataPtr</code>. The interface is declared via the header file <code>Com.h</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Parameters</h4>
  <ul>
    <li><code>SignalId</code>: Unique identifier of the signal to be transmitted (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>SignalDataPtr</code>: Pointer to the signal payload data to be transmitted (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>MetaDataPtr</code>: Pointer to the metadata of the signal (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Return Values and Error Handling</h4>
  <p>The return value of type <code>uint8</code> reports the status of acceptance by the COM module (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>):</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service request was successfully accepted (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the call failed due to a development error (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The transport protocol buffer (TP buffer) is locked for processing large data types (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>The service is reentrant for different signals, but not reentrant for the same signal (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91009">[SWS_Com_91009]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Interaction</h4>
  <p>While <code>Com_SendSignal</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00197" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00197">[SWS_Com_00197]</a>) updates signal data without additional metadata, this function passes metadata directly at the signal level. The synchronous counterpart on the receiver side is formed by <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>). At the PDU level, <code>Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>) serves for transmission taking metadata into account.</p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note is based on the definitions in the specification AUTOSAR Classic Release R20-11.</p>
</div>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="a9c427f704f0db5f1b54e1f21a1200c0857e2d7f03c32676bd0d4286239c2c51" data-trace-output="1cce4b7c9925f62ed77dcc09adddf58be4cd280d3eb5ed6121834c130d5d91a8" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>use</h4>
  <p>
    According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91010">[SWS_Com_91010]</a>, the function <code>Com_SendDynSignalWithMetaData</code> updates the signal object identified via <code>SignalId</code> with the signal data referenced by <code>SignalDataPtr</code> and provides additional metadata via <code>MetaDataPtr</code>. The execution of the service is asynchronous (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91010">[SWS_Com_91010]</a>).
  </p>
  <p>
    The input parameters include (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91010">[SWS_Com_91010]</a>):
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>SignalId</code>: Identifier of the signal to be transmitted.</li>
    <li><code>SignalDataPtr</code>: Reference to the signal data to be transmitted.</li>
    <li><code>Length</code>: Length of the signal with dynamic length.</li>
    <li><code>MetaDataPtr</code>: Pointer to the metadata of the signal.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Error Handling and Return Values</h4>
  <p>
    The function returns a status value of type <code>uint8</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91010">[SWS_Com_91010]</a>):
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service was successfully accepted.</li>
    <li><code>E_NOT_OK</code>: The specified <code>Length</code> exceeds the configured length <code>ComSignalLength</code> of the transmitted signal.</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group was stopped, or the service failed as a result of a development error.</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer is currently locked.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    With regard to concurrent access, the function is not reentrant for the same signal, but reentrant for different signals (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91010">[SWS_Com_91010]</a>).
  </p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the specification AUTOSAR Classic R20-11.</p>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="a0542ac403d9674d880e05f1c1eb7922cdd436d327c327a19cb08d0cd54536b5" data-trace-output="bb1af5c79ea10760f19d528e6b70825fe578054cbb5ba25bbce9f853d507b044" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <p>
    The function <code>Com_SendSignalGroupWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>) serves for asynchronously transmitting a signal group together with metadata. Upon call, the service copies the contents of the assigned shadow buffer (Shadow Buffer) into the corresponding I-PDU (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>). The metadata to be transmitted is passed via the pointer parameter <code>Meta Data Ptr</code>, while <code>Signal Group Id</code> identifies the signal group to be sent (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>). The function declaration is provided via header <code>Com.h</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>).
  </p>

  <h4>Return Values and Error Handling</h4>
  <p>
    The return value of type <code>uint8</code> signals the result of request acceptance (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>):
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The transmit request was successfully accepted by the communication module (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the service failed due to a development error (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer is locked for processing large data types (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    Regarding reentrancy, the service is reentrant for different signal groups, but not reentrant for the same signal group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91011">[SWS_Com_91011]</a>). Interpretation: Prior to triggering the copy operation into the I-PDU, the individual group signals in the shadow buffer are likely to have been fully updated in order to ensure data consistency within the group.
  </p>

  <h4>Interaction</h4>
  <p>
    The service joins the signal and PDU processing functions of module <code>Com</code>. It extends the regular transmission of individual signals via <code>Com_SendSignal</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00197" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00197">[SWS_Com_00197]</a>) or the invalidation of signal groups via <code>Com_InvalidateSignalGroup</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00557" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00557">[SWS_Com_00557]</a>) by directly providing metadata. In addition, other metadata-capable services exist in the module, such as PDU-based <code>Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>) on the transmit side or <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>) on the receive side.
  </p>

  <p class="ai-note">This usage note was generated automatically based on the AUTOSAR specification R20-11.</p>

<div class="ai usage" data-trace-prompt="bfd14e2fcae6fb01066d8667dca857559a8dbe0b0cd168185dd66263738671ff" data-trace-output="da590a2e2f59c9095e7f91c01c161ae13e83b82fcf5a4889de1f67c9f8c5d8a4" data-trace-model="gemini-3.8-flash-medium" data-trace-review="unreviewed" data-trace-effort="medium">

  <h4>Usage and Semantics</h4>
  <p>
    The function <code>Com_SendSignalGroupArrayWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91012" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91012">[SWS_Com_91012]</a>) serves for asynchronously transmitting a signal group together with associated metadata. Upon call, the service copies the payload data from pointer <code>SignalGroupArrayPtr</code>, which must correspond to the array representation of the signal group, into the assigned I-PDU. The associated metadata is passed via pointer <code>MetaDataPtr</code>. The signal group is addressed via identifier <code>SignalGroupId</code>.
  </p>

  <h4>Return Values and Error Handling</h4>
  <p>
    The function returns a status value of type <code>uint8</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91012" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91012">[SWS_Com_91012]</a>):
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>E_OK</code>: The service call was successfully accepted.</li>
    <li><code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>: The associated I-PDU group is stopped or the call failed due to a development error.</li>
    <li><code>COM_BUSY</code>: The TP buffer is locked for processing large data types.</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Concurrency and Limitations</h4>
  <p>
    According to <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91012" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91012">[SWS_Com_91012]</a>, the interface is specified as non-reentrant (<em>Non Reentrant</em>). Callers must therefore ensure that concurrent calls for the same or dependent instances are avoided or synchronized on the caller side. Since the service operates asynchronously, the request is initially accepted and the I-PDU is further processed decoupled in time. Header <code>Com.h</code> provides the declaration.
  </p>

  <p class="ai-note">
    This usage note is based on the specification requirements for <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91012" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91012">[SWS_Com_91012]</a> from AUTOSAR Classic R20-11.
  </p>
</div>

<h4>Role in the communication stack: signals at the top, I-PDUs at the bottom</h4>
<p>AUTOSAR COM connects the signal-oriented view of the RTE with the PDU-oriented lower layers. Upwards, COM provides transmit and receive services for individual signals, signals of dynamic length, and signal groups, such as <code>Com_SendSignal</code>, <code>Com_ReceiveSignal</code>, <code>Com_SendSignalGroup</code>, and <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroup</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00197" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00197">[SWS_Com_00197]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00198" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00198">[SWS_Com_00198]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00200" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00200">[SWS_Com_00200]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00201" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00201">[SWS_Com_00201]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00627" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00627">[SWS_Com_00627]</a>). Downwards, the PDU Router is the only partner. COM transmits via <code>PduR_ComTransmit</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00669" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00669">[SWS_Com_00669]</a>). Conversely, the PduR calls <code>Com_RxIndication</code>, <code>Com_TxConfirmation</code>, <code>Com_TriggerTransmit</code>, and the TP functions of COM (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_5_Dependencies_to_other_modules_PDUROUTER.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_5_Dependencies_to_other_modules_PDUROUTER">SWS PduR p. 24</a>).</p>
<p>The BswM controls COM from the side. It starts and stops I-PDU groups, switches receive deadline monitoring, and selects the transmission mode (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_8_6_2_Optional_Interfaces_BSWMODEMANAGER.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_8_6_2_Optional_Interfaces_BSWMODEMANAGER">SWS BswM p. 93</a>). COM reports development and runtime errors to the DET (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00670" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00670">[SWS_Com_00670]</a>). The supported data types are <code>boolean</code>, unsigned and signed integers up to 64 bits, <code>float32</code>/<code>float64</code>, and <code>uint8[n]</code>. The latter is mapped to <code>UINT8_N</code> or <code>UINT8_DYN</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00675" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00675">[SWS_Com_00675]</a>), and such signals must be byte-aligned (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00105" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00105">[SWS_Com_00105]</a>).</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Context diagram: COM is located between RTE and PduR, is controlled by the BswM, and reports errors to the DET. Sources: <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_5_Dependencies_to_other_modules_PDUROUTER.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_5_Dependencies_to_other_modules_PDUROUTER">SWS PduR p. 24</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_8_6_2_Optional_Interfaces_BSWMODEMANAGER.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMM_SECTION_8_6_2_Optional_Interfaces_BSWMODEMANAGER">SWS BswM p. 93</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00669" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00669">[SWS_Com_00669]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00670" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00670">[SWS_Com_00670]</a></p>

<h4>Lifecycle: Com_Init, I-PDU groups, and Com_DeInit</h4>
<p><code>Com_Init</code> initializes the internal and external interfaces. However, communication between ECUs remains blocked afterwards (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00432" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00432">[SWS_Com_00432]</a>). An exception is made for I-PDUs that are not assigned to any group. <code>Com_Init</code> starts them itself, as if <code>Com_IpduGroupStart</code> had been called with <code>initialize = true</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00840" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00840">[SWS_Com_00840]</a>). Their initial transmission mode results from the <code>ComSignalInitValue</code>s (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00877" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00877">[SWS_Com_00877]</a>). <code>Com_GetStatus</code> provides the module state <code>COM_UNINIT</code>/<code>COM_INIT</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00194" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00194">[SWS_Com_00194]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00819" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00819">[SWS_Com_00819]</a>).</p>
<p>An I-PDU is active as soon as at least one of its groups is started (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00771" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00771">[SWS_Com_00771]</a>). All I-PDUs of a group have the same <code>ComIPduDirection</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00871" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00871">[SWS_Com_00871]</a>).</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Com_IpduGroupStart</code> starts a group. With <code>initialize = true</code>, its I-PDU data is reinitialized (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91001">[SWS_Com_91001]</a>). In the BswM, this corresponds to the parameter <code>BswMPduGroupSwitchReinit</code> (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_72_BswMPduGroupSwitch.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_72_BswMPduGroupSwitch">SWS BswM p. 165</a>).</li>
<li>The first cyclic transmission after starting the group follows after the <code>timeOffset</code> of the <code>CyclicTiming</code> (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_SYSTEMTEMPLATE_FIGURE_Figure_6_21.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_SYSTEMTEMPLATE_FIGURE_Figure_6_21">SystemTemplate p. 268</a>).</li>
<li><code>Com_IpduGroupStop</code> cancels pending transmit requests of the affected I-PDUs, including retries (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00777" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00777">[SWS_Com_00777]</a>). COM ignores transmit confirmations arriving afterwards (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00800" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00800">[SWS_Com_00800]</a>).</li>
<li><code>Com_DeInit</code> stops all started groups and sets COM to the uninitialized state (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00130" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00130">[SWS_Com_00130]</a>).</li>
</ul>

<p class="diagram-note">State diagram: Lifecycle of an I-PDU between module initialization, group start/stop, and deinitialization. Sources: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00432" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00432">[SWS_Com_00432]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00840" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00840">[SWS_Com_00840]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00771" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00771">[SWS_Com_00771]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91001">[SWS_Com_91001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91002">[SWS_Com_91002]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00130" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00130">[SWS_Com_00130]</a></p>

<h4>Transmission: from signal value to confirmed I-PDU</h4>
<p>For atomic data, the RTE writes each group signal individually with <code>Com_SendSignal</code>. It then triggers the transmission with <code>Com_SendSignalGroup</code> (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity">SWS RTE p. 329</a>). In doing so, COM sets the update bit of the group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00801" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00801">[SWS_Com_00801]</a>). The transmit services operate asynchronously. They return <code>E_OK</code> or <code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code> if the associated I-PDU group is stopped (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00197" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00197">[SWS_Com_00197]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00865" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00865">[SWS_Com_00865]</a>).</p>
<p>What the functions called by the RTE do not handle directly is taken over by <code>Com_MainFunctionTx</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00399" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00399">[SWS_Com_00399]</a>). Before I-PDU processing, it calls <code>Com_CbkTxPrep</code> if required (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00886" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00886">[SWS_Com_00886]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91013" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91013">[SWS_Com_91013]</a>). If a configured <code>Com_TxIpduCallout</code> returns <code>false</code>, the I-PDU is not processed further (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00346" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00346">[SWS_Com_00346]</a>). If retries are configured, the minimum delay only starts if <code>PduR_ComTransmit</code> returns <code>E_OK</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00828" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00828">[SWS_Com_00828]</a>). <code>Com_TxConfirmation</code> reports success or failure (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00124" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00124">[SWS_Com_00124]</a>), and each successful transmission triggers the configured notification (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00883" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00883">[SWS_Com_00883]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00468" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00468">[SWS_Com_00468]</a>).</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Sequence diagram: A signal group is filled, transmitted via PduR and CanIf, and confirmed. Sources: <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity">SWS RTE p. 329</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_7_1_I_PDU_handling.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_7_1_I_PDU_handling">SWS PduR p. 33</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00399" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00399">[SWS_Com_00399]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00124" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00124">[SWS_Com_00124]</a></p>
<p>For trigger-transmit bus interfaces such as FlexRay, the interface initially only remembers the transmission request. It requests the data later via the PduR with <code>Com_TriggerTransmit</code> (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_9_2_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_transmission.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_9_2_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_transmission">SWS PduR p. 106</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00001">[SWS_Com_00001]</a>). In two cases, COM does not copy anything and returns <code>E_NOT_OK</code>: if the buffer is too small or the I-PDU is stopped (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00869" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00869">[SWS_Com_00869]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00884" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00884">[SWS_Com_00884]</a>).</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Sequence diagram: With Trigger Transmit, the transmission request and data retrieval are decoupled in time. Sources: <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_9_2_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_transmission.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_FRIF_SECTION_9_2_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_transmission">SWS PduR p. 106</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00001">[SWS_Com_00001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00869" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00869">[SWS_Com_00869]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00884" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00884">[SWS_Com_00884]</a></p>
<p>The transmission time can be influenced externally in three ways:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Com_SwitchIpduTxMode</code> sets the transmission mode. Cyclic transmissions are shifted by <code>ComTxModeTimeOffset</code> in the process (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00784" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00784">[SWS_Com_00784]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00881" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00881">[SWS_Com_00881]</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_84_BswMSwitchIPduMode.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_84_BswMSwitchIPduMode">SWS BswM p. 178</a>).</li>
<li><code>Com_TriggerIPDUSend</code> triggers a single transmission, regardless of the transmission mode. This is effective only if the I-PDU is started (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00348" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00348">[SWS_Com_00348]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00861" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00861">[SWS_Com_00861]</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_SYSTEMTEMPLATE_SECTION_6_4_4_Configuration_of_a_trigger_for_COM_TriggerIPduSend_API_call.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_SYSTEMTEMPLATE_SECTION_6_4_4_Configuration_of_a_trigger_for_COM_TriggerIPduSend_API_call">SystemTemplate p. 371</a>).</li>
<li><code>Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData</code> works similarly, but passes metadata that applies only to this single transmission (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00858" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00858">[SWS_Com_00858]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00862" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00862">[SWS_Com_00862]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00887" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00887">[SWS_Com_00887]</a>). The J1939Rm uses this variant (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_CANIF_SECTION_9_3_Handling_of_Request_for_a_COM_Pdu.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_CANIF_SECTION_9_3_Handling_of_Request_for_a_COM_Pdu">SWS J1939Rm p. 62</a>).</li>
</ul>

<h4>Reception: check chain and consistent signal groups</h4>
<p>The PduR passes received I-PDUs with <code>Com_RxIndication</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00123" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00123">[SWS_Com_00123]</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_9_1_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_reception.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_9_1_2_FrIf_module_I_PDU_reception">SWS PduR p. 103</a>). COM then runs through a check chain:</p>
<ol>
<li>A configured Rx callout receives the complete I-PDU. It is always called, specifically before counter handling (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00816" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00816">[SWS_Com_00816]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00889" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00889">[SWS_Com_00889]</a>). If it returns <code>false</code>, the I-PDU is not processed (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00700" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00700">[SWS_Com_00700]</a>).</li>
<li>If the I-PDU counter differs, COM calls <code>Com_CbkCounterErr</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00726" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00726">[SWS_Com_00726]</a>).</li>
<li>If the update bit is not set, the signal is discarded (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00802" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00802">[SWS_Com_00802]</a>). If the update bit is missing because the I-PDU is too short, the signal is considered updated (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00794" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00794">[SWS_Com_00794]</a>).</li>
<li>If COM filters out a group signal, it discards the entire signal group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00836" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00836">[SWS_Com_00836]</a>).</li>
</ol>

<p class="diagram-note">Activity diagram: Branches during reception of an I-PDU up to the notification. Interpretation: The sequence of update bit before filter is shown, but not verified. Sources: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00889" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00889">[SWS_Com_00889]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00700" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00700">[SWS_Com_00700]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00802" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00802">[SWS_Com_00802]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00794" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00794">[SWS_Com_00794]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00836" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00836">[SWS_Com_00836]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00555" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00555">[SWS_Com_00555]</a></p>
<p>On the receive side, the RTE calls <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroup</code> exactly once and then reads the group signals with <code>Com_ReceiveSignal</code>. COM only notifies once all signals of the group are unpacked into a buffer (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_3_1_11_2_Atomicity">SWS RTE p. 329</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00201" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00201">[SWS_Com_00201]</a>). COM stores received metadata for access via <code>Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00888" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00888">[SWS_Com_00888]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91005">[SWS_Com_91005]</a>).</p>

<h4>Array access, large I-PDUs, and transformers</h4>
<p><code>Com_SendSignalGroupArray</code> and <code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupArray</code> transport a signal group as a <code>uint8</code> array. The array extends from the start byte of the group signal with the smallest to the last byte of the group signal with the highest <code>ComBitPosition</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00851" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00851">[SWS_Com_00851]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00854" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00854">[SWS_Com_00854]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00844" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00844">[SWS_Com_00844]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00845" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00845">[SWS_Com_00845]</a>). Conditions apply to this access:</p>
<ul>
<li>The group contains only fixed-size data, is byte-aligned, and does not enclose any foreign signals (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00841" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00841">[SWS_Com_00841]</a>).</li>
<li>For such a group, the individual signal and normal group APIs are not available (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00843" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00843">[SWS_Com_00843]</a>).</li>
<li>The APIs must be enabled via <code>ComEnableSignalGroupArrayApi</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00853" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00853">[SWS_Com_00853]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00856" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00856">[SWS_Com_00856]</a>).</li>
</ul>
<p>For transmission mode selection, COM treats array transmission like <code>Com_SendSignalGroup</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00847" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00847">[SWS_Com_00847]</a>). The COM Based Transformer uses precisely this path (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_7_Functional_specification_COMBASEDTRANSFORMER.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_7_Functional_specification_COMBASEDTRANSFORMER">SWS ComXf p. 14</a>).</p>
<p>Large I-PDUs run via the TP interface. For reception, these are <code>Com_StartOfReception</code>, <code>Com_CopyRxData</code>, and <code>Com_TpRxIndication</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00691" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00691">[SWS_Com_00691]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00692" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00692">[SWS_Com_00692]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00650" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00650">[SWS_Com_00650]</a>). With <code>TpSduLength = 0</code>, COM reports back the configured maximum length (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00874" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00874">[SWS_Com_00874]</a>). For transmission, these are <code>Com_CopyTxData</code> and <code>Com_TpTxConfirmation</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00693" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00693">[SWS_Com_00693]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00725" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00725">[SWS_Com_00725]</a>, <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_STD_SECTION_9_1_4_Authentication_with_upper_layer_transport_protocol.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_STD_SECTION_9_1_4_Authentication_with_upper_layer_transport_protocol">SWS SecOC p. 108</a>). If another transmit request arrives during an ongoing transmission, COM skips it (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00863" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00863">[SWS_Com_00863]</a>). In contrast, a <code>Com_TriggerIPDUSend</code> with a locked buffer is stored and performed later (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00867" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00867">[SWS_Com_00867]</a>).</p>

<h4>Main functions, time monitoring, and signal gateway</h4>
<p>COM has three cyclic main functions: <code>Com_MainFunctionRx</code>, <code>Com_MainFunctionTx</code>, and <code>Com_MainFunctionRouteSignals</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00398" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00398">[SWS_Com_00398]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00399" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00399">[SWS_Com_00399]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00400" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00400">[SWS_Com_00400]</a>). Their periods are described by the time bases <code>comConfigurationRxTimeBase</code>, <code>comConfigurationTxTimeBase</code>, and <code>comConfigurationGwTimeBase</code> (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_SOFTWARECOMPONENTTEMPLATE_SECTION_13_4_Modi_cations_of_the_Meta_Model_for_supporting_the_RPT_scenario.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_SOFTWARECOMPONENTTEMPLATE_SECTION_13_4_Modi_cations_of_the_Meta_Model_for_supporting_the_RPT_scenario">SWC-Template p. 841</a>). If there are multiple instances of a main function, <code>ComIPduMainFunctionRef</code> assigns each I-PDU to one of them (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_8_16_2_Configuration_of_Com_Callbacks.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_8_16_2_Configuration_of_Com_Callbacks">SWS RTE p. 1470</a>).</p>
<p>Transmit deadline monitoring works as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li>The timer starts upon transmission, provided it is not already running. For the first start after a (re)start of monitoring, <code>ComFirstTimeout</code> applies, otherwise <code>ComTimeout</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00878" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00878">[SWS_Com_00878]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00879" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00879">[SWS_Com_00879]</a>).</li>
<li>A transmit confirmation stops the timers (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00880" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00880">[SWS_Com_00880]</a>).</li>
<li>If a timer expires, COM calls the <code>ComTimeoutNotification</code>s (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00304" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00304">[SWS_Com_00304]</a>).</li>
<li>In transmission mode NONE, monitoring is disabled (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00835" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00835">[SWS_Com_00835]</a>).</li>
</ul>
<p>Upon reception, a timeout can replace the values with <code>ComTimeoutSubstitutionValue</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00875" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00875">[SWS_Com_00875]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00876" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00876">[SWS_Com_00876]</a>). This monitoring can be enabled and disabled per group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91003" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91003">[SWS_Com_91003]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_91004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_91004">[SWS_Com_91004]</a>).</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Activity diagram: Start, cancellation, and expiration of transmit deadline monitoring. Sources: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00835" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00835">[SWS_Com_00835]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00878" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00878">[SWS_Com_00878]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00879" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00879">[SWS_Com_00879]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00880" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00880">[SWS_Com_00880]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00304" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00304">[SWS_Com_00304]</a></p>
<p>The signal gateway is an integral part of COM (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_FIGURE_Figure_4_1_GATEWAY.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_FIGURE_Figure_4_1_GATEWAY">SRS Gateway p. 11</a>). It can route group signals to individual signals (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00833" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00833">[SWS_Com_00833]</a>) and undergoes defined processing stages on the receive and transmit sides (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00872" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00872">[SWS_Com_00872]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00873" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00873">[SWS_Com_00873]</a>).</p>

<h4>Behavior in the event of an error</h4>
<ul>
<li>COM reports development errors to <code>Det_ReportError</code> with ModuleId 50 (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00442" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00442">[SWS_Com_00442]</a>). The error codes are:
<ul>
<li><code>COM_E_PARAM</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00803" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00803">[SWS_Com_00803]</a>)</li>
<li><code>COM_E_UNINIT</code> for API calls before <code>Com_Init</code> or after <code>Com_DeInit</code>, except for status, version, and main functions (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00804" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00804">[SWS_Com_00804]</a>)</li>
<li><code>COM_E_PARAM_POINTER</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00805" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00805">[SWS_Com_00805]</a>)</li>
<li><code>COM_E_INIT_FAILED</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00837" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00837">[SWS_Com_00837]</a>)</li>
</ul></li>
<li>A skipped transmit request of a large I-PDU is reported as runtime error <code>COM_E_SKIPPED_TRANSMISSION</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00863" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00863">[SWS_Com_00863]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00864" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00864">[SWS_Com_00864]</a>).</li>
<li>When a group is stopped, the services return <code>COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE</code>. If the buffer of a large I-PDU is locked, <code>COM_BUSY</code> may be returned (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00865" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00865">[SWS_Com_00865]</a>). <code>Com_CbkTxErr</code> indicates a transmission attempt with a stopped group (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00491" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00491">[SWS_Com_00491]</a>).</li>
<li>A TP reception with <code>E_NOT_OK</code> or a callout result <code>false</code> causes COM to treat all signals of the I-PDU as invalidated and execute the <code>ComDataInvalidAction</code>s (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00838" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00838">[SWS_Com_00838]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00839" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00839">[SWS_Com_00839]</a>).</li>
<li>On the sender side, <code>Com_InvalidateSignal</code> and <code>Com_InvalidateSignalGroup</code> invalidate values (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00203" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00203">[SWS_Com_00203]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00557" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00557">[SWS_Com_00557]</a>). On the receiver side, a configured invalid value also requires a <code>ComDataInvalidAction</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00859" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00859">[SWS_Com_00859]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00860" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00860">[SWS_Com_00860]</a>). The reception of invalid values is reported via <code>Com_CbkInv</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00536" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00536">[SWS_Com_00536]</a>).</li>
<li><code>Com_ReceiveSignalGroupArray</code> returns the last known data or initial values even when the I-PDU is stopped (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00857" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00857">[SWS_Com_00857]</a>).</li>
</ul>

<h4>Further detailed evidence</h4>
<ul>
<li>API core and status types: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00432" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00432">[SWS_Com_00432]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00130" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00130">[SWS_Com_00130]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00825" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00825">[SWS_Com_00825]</a> (implementation-specific <code>Com_ConfigType</code>), <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00820" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00820">[SWS_Com_00820]</a>/<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00822" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00822">[SWS_Com_00822]</a> (identifier types).</li>
<li>Symbolic names of the <code>ComSignal</code> handles are generated from the configuration (<a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_FIGURE_Figure_2_30.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_FIGURE_Figure_2_30">ECU Configuration p. 138</a>).</li>
<li><a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_7_1_I_PDU_handling.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COMSTACK_SECTION_7_1_I_PDU_handling">SWS PduR p. 33</a> shows the interaction between PduR and handle IDs on the transmission and confirmation path.</li>
<li>Control by the BswM is described by <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_58_BswMDeadlineMonitoringControl.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_58_BswMDeadlineMonitoringControl">SWS BswM p. 148</a> (deadline monitoring) and <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_72_BswMPduGroupSwitch.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_10_2_72_BswMPduGroupSwitch">SWS BswM p. 165</a> (groups).</li>
<li>For array access and transformers: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00846" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00846">[SWS_Com_00846]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00848" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00848">[SWS_Com_00848]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Com_00850" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Com_00850">[SWS_Com_00850]</a>, and <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_LAYEREDSOFTWAREARCHITECTURE_SECTION_1_SC_D.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_LAYEREDSOFTWAREARCHITECTURE_SECTION_1_SC_D">Layered SW Architecture p. 103</a>.</li>
<li><a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_1_5_Generation_of_the_BSW_Scheduler.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_4_1_5_Generation_of_the_BSW_Scheduler">SRS RTE p. 41</a> covers the cyclic scheduling of <code>Com_MainFunctionTx</code> by the RTE. <a class="docref internal-spec-ref" href="../../../spec/snippets/SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_5_9_2_1_7_Rte_COMCbkTxPrep__mn.html" data-snip="SNIP_CLASSIC_COM_SECTION_5_9_2_1_7_Rte_COMCbkTxPrep__mn">SWS RTE p. 832</a> describes the callback <code>Rte_COMCbkTxPrep</code>.</li>
</ul>
